# Vendored sfvr modules

The canonical source is [astromaddie/sfvr](https://github.com/astromaddie/sfvr), licensed under MIT; a copy of that license is in `LICENSE`.

This GTA San Andreas port vendors only `sfvr_adjust` and `sfvr_camera`, copied from source revision `b09b6e1cb68ac17cf5e68bdaa867fefcd2e0121c`. Their headers and implementations are the complete upstream files for those modules. The surrounding port remains under this repository's separate license.
